name: ChapterEvents - Community Heading
description: The same events section a chapter page renders, with the heading overridden for a community. The default phrasing is built from the page's subject — fine for a place ('Upcoming Events in San Francisco'), wrong for a group ('Upcoming Events in Founders'), so /communities passes 'Upcoming Founders Events' instead. The cards themselves are the shared EventCards, unchanged, which is the point: only the sentence above them differs.
